ex.s: Most of us would assume that urban development and climate change are responsible for pushing the animals out of their natural habitats.
ex.t: 我们大多数人会认为，城市发展和气候变化是把动物赶出自然栖息地的罪魁祸首。

ex.s: However true this is, we also need to consider that some of these so-called “urban animals” have never moved at all ‒ it’s we humans who have moved into their territory.
ex.t: 无论这是否属实，我们也要考虑到，有些所谓的“城市动物”根本从未移动过——搬进它们领地的是我们人类。

ex.s: One thing crucial to the increasing number of “urban animals” is their ability to adapt.
ex.t: 对“城市动物”数量增长至关重要的是它们适应（环境）的能力。

ex.s: There is evidence that urban racoons are more intelligent than their wild cousins, as they frequently have to figure out difficult problems such as how to open rubbish bins and other containers which they would not find in the wild.
ex.t: 有证据表明，城市中的浣熊比它们在野外的近亲更聪明，因为它们经常得想办法解决难题，比如如何打开垃圾桶和其他在野外不会遇到的容器。
